summary: Registers the Enumservice vCard, using http and https URIs, so that an ENUM domain name for a phone number can point to a vCard describing its user. For example, a callee could see the caller's name and affiliation before answering. It is a standards-track IANA registration.

eli5.summary: Link a phone number to a digital business card so you can see who is calling.

questions: how does enum link phone numbers to vcards
